// domain: Intentionally null for the pilot: the app is not routed through Traefik and has no public DNS name. Access is the Tailscale-IP port published below (http://100.71.130.57:8787). When the public flip happens, set this to hivebot.hivemindnetwork.com, add the four router labels to the app service, and create the explicit A record BEFORE the first certificate request.
// authMode: grid-app-auth.md defines "bios" as "the app enforces its own authentication"; the name is generic, not BIOS-SSO-specific. This app enforces a single-owner scrypt password login plus its own session cookie. BIOS SSO was considered and deliberately deferred (HIVA-26487).
deployCommands: cd /srv/stack && docker compose pull hivebot hivebot-desktop
cd /srv/stack && docker compose up -d hivebot hivebot-desktop
// smokeCheck: hive-deploy treats any 4xx as healthy by default (HIVA-19789 lesson). The app serves the built SPA at / and /api/health returns 200, so demand < 400. For an unrouted app the probe has no edge hostname; if the renderer skips the check for a null domain, that is expected and not a pass.

# -- hivebot -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-hosted agent-team app (HiveMind-Network-Ltd/hivebot, a fork of
  # Zburgers/grokbot-clone, MIT) plus its browser desktop. HIVA-26487.
  #
  # TWO SERVICES, TWO IMAGES:
  #   hivebot          Hono server + built React app on 8787. The only container
  #                    that holds credentials (LLM key, Composio key, session
  #                    secret, owner password hash).
  #   hivebot-desktop  Xvfb/openbox/Chromium/desktopd on 8090, from the repo's
  #                    own desktop/Dockerfile. Unrouted, unpublished, and given
  #                    ONLY desktop.env, so it holds no application credential.
  #                    It is the container that runs shell commands and drives a
  #                    browser, so the split is the containment: an app-side bug
  #                    cannot already be a browser-with-keys bug, and the reverse
  #                    is true as well.
  #
  # NETWORK. `hivebot-net` (declared in templates/compose-header.yml, NOT
  # internal — both services need public egress: DeepSeek, Composio, and general
  # browsing) is joined by these two services and nothing else. Neither joins
  # `default`, so no other Grid app can reach the desktop's shell API. Precedent
  # for a non-internal, non-default network with a Tailscale-IP published port:
  # voice-meet-internal and codebeam-egress.
  #
  # EXPOSURE. Tailscale-only for the pilot, by Lyndon's decision (HIVA-26487):
  # the port binds 100.71.130.57, never 0.0.0.0, so there is no public listener.
  # traefik.enable=false on both. No DNS record and no certificate exist for
  # this app yet. Container -> Tailnet egress remains default-denied by
  # scripts/docker-tailnet-guard.sh; no allow row is needed because the model
  # endpoint is public.
  #
  # env_file is required: false on purpose, exactly as for hm-mail and
  # hive-drop: /admin/reload validates the WHOLE stack with `docker compose
  # config -q`, and a required env_file that an operator has not placed yet
  # fails the render with 422 and queues every other merged change behind it.
  # With required: false the container starts and serves 500s until the file
  # exists and the service is recreated.
  #
  # Runtime config, two operator-placed files (mode 640, deploy:deploy):
  #   ./hivebot/.env          app only — every name in envVarNames above
  #   ./hivebot/desktop.env   desktop only — DESKTOP_TOKEN (must equal the app's
  #                           copy) and optionally RESOLUTION
  # Do not merge them. The desktop must never receive LLM_API_KEY,
  # COMPOSIO_API_KEY, SESSION_SECRET or OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH.
  #
  # HOST=0.0.0.0 inside the container; exposure is the port binding below.
  # APP_URL/SERVER_URL must equal the URL actually used (cookie `Secure` is set
  # only when APP_URL starts with https, so an http pilot and a later https
  # cutover are deliberately different configurations).
  #
  # MEMORY. 768m app / 2560m desktop (the desktop's own documented profile, with
  # 1g /dev/shm for Chromium). Total ~3.3 GiB at limits on a 16 GiB host.
  # Single replica only: SQLite WAL, an in-process cron scheduler and an
  # in-memory login-failure counter all assume one process.
  hivebot:
    image: ghcr.io/hivemind-network-ltd/hivebot:latest
    mem_limit: 768m
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
    - path: ./hivebot/.env
      required: false
    volumes:
    - hivebot-data:/data
    networks:
    - hivebot-net
    ports:
    - "100.71.130.57:8787:8787"
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=false
  hivebot-desktop:
    image: ghcr.io/hivemind-network-ltd/hivebot-desktop:latest
    mem_limit: 2560m
    cpus: 2.0
    pids_limit: 512
    shm_size: "1g"
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
    - path: ./hivebot/desktop.env
      required: false
    volumes:
    - hivebot-desktop-data:/home/agent/grokbot
    networks:
    - hivebot-net
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    labels:
    - traefik.enable=false
